concepts.quote: makes the division a double division
concepts.why: Implies that a double operand makes / a floating-point division, but names no line, value or result, so the rule is stated rather than applied to q or r.

concepts.quote: The cast makes the division a double division.
concepts.why: True for (double) i / 2 (cast binds before /), but the answer does not say which cast, ignores that (double)(i / 2) casts an already-truncated int, and gives no values, so it does not explain why q and r differ.
The answer says nothing about primitive types, widening or narrowing.
